description: Curated, DA-anchored architecture compositions for Terraform IBM Modules (TIM). Each composition captures the recommended module stack, deployment order, and inter-module wiring needed to build a common IBM Cloud architecture pattern. Each entry is anchored to a real Deployable Architecture (DA) solution via 'reference_solution' (fetch it with get_content to see ground-truth wiring). Every module carries a 'role': 'core' (composed by the anchor DA), 'prerequisite' (infra the DA expects to already exist, provisioned here for an end-to-end stack), or 'optional' (add-ons the DA does not include). Module versions and registry sources are resolved at runtime from the module index, so this file stores only base module IDs (namespace/name/provider).

compositions.name: openshift
compositions.description: Production-grade Red Hat OpenShift (ROKS) cluster on a VPC with customer-managed encryption (KMS), a COS instance for the internal image registry, and Cloud Logs plus Cloud Monitoring for observability. Anchored on the base-ocp-vpc 'fully-configurable' DA, extended with VPC and COS provisioning (which that DA expects to already exist) for an end-to-end stack.

recommended_modules.purpose: Creates (or references) the resource group that owns every resource in the stack.
Provisions a Key Protect (or HPCS) instance, key ring, and root key for customer-managed encryption.
Provisions the OpenShift cluster and worker pools on the VPC (the anchor DA's module).
Provisions the VPC, subnets across zones, and public gateways. The DA expects an existing VPC (existing_vpc_crn / existing_subnet_ids); this provisions it.
Provisions the COS instance for the OpenShift internal image registry. The DA expects an existing COS (existing_cos_instance_crn); this provisions it.
Provisions IBM Cloud Logs for platform and application log aggregation (not part of the anchor DA).
Provisions IBM Cloud Monitoring for cluster and workload metrics (not part of the anchor DA).

connections.note: Set use_existing_cos = true and enable_registry_storage = true so the cluster uses this COS instance for its internal registry.
Boot-volume encryption is configured per worker pool; supply the KMS key CRN (crk) and KMS instance GUID inside each worker pool's boot_volume_encryption_kms_config object.

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud API key with permissions to provision the listed services.

prerequisites.name: region
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud region to deploy into (e.g. us-south).

prerequisites.name: resource_group_name
prerequisites.description: Name of the resource group to create or reuse.

prerequisites.name: prefix
prerequisites.description: Short prefix prepended to resource names to keep them unique.

notes: Anchor DA (base-ocp-vpc/solutions/fully-configurable) composes resource_group + kms + the cluster and takes an EXISTING VPC and COS as input; the vpc and cos modules here (role=prerequisite) provision those so the stack is end-to-end.
For dev/test, drop cloud_logs and cloud_monitoring (role=optional) and use a single-zone VPC to reduce cost.
base-ocp-vpc encrypts worker boot volumes through the worker_pools object rather than a single top-level KMS input.

compositions.name: postgresql
compositions.description: A managed PostgreSQL database with customer-managed encryption (KMS) and its credentials stored in Secrets Manager. Anchored on the icd-postgresql 'fully-configurable' DA (resource_group + kms + database, writing credentials into Secrets Manager), extended with a Secrets Manager instance for an end-to-end stack.

recommended_modules.purpose: Creates (or references) the resource group that owns the database and encryption resources.
Provisions the KMS instance, key ring, and root key used to encrypt the database at rest.
Provisions the managed PostgreSQL instance encrypted with the customer-managed KMS key (the anchor DA's module).
Provisions Secrets Manager to hold the database credentials. The DA writes credentials into an EXISTING Secrets Manager via its secrets submodule; this provisions one.

connections.note: Set use_ibm_owned_encryption_key = false on the postgresql module so the customer-managed key is used.
Set kms_encryption_enabled = true on the secrets_manager module to encrypt stored secrets with the customer-managed key.

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud API key with permissions to provision the listed services.

prerequisites.name: region
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud region to deploy into (e.g. us-south).

prerequisites.name: resource_group_name
prerequisites.description: Name of the resource group to create or reuse.

notes: A service-to-service authorization is required so the database service can read the KMS key; kms-all-inclusive can create it, or add an s2s-auth module.
The same pattern applies to the other ICD engines (icd-mysql, icd-redis, icd-mongodb, icd-elasticsearch) by swapping the database module and its anchor DA.
To match the DA exactly, drop the secrets_manager module (role=optional) and use secrets-manager//modules/secrets against an existing Secrets Manager instance.

compositions.name: watsonx-ai
compositions.description: A watsonx.ai Studio and Runtime foundation backed by an encrypted COS instance for project storage, with customer-managed encryption (KMS). Anchored on the watsonx-ai 'fully-configurable' DA (resource_group + kms + watsonx.ai), extended with COS provisioning (which that DA expects to already exist).

recommended_modules.purpose: Creates (or references) the resource group that owns the watsonx and storage resources.
Provisions the KMS instance, key ring, and root key used to encrypt the COS storage.
Provisions watsonx.ai Studio and Runtime and an initial project wired to the COS instance (the anchor DA's module).
Provisions the COS instance for watsonx.ai project and asset storage. The DA expects an existing COS (cos_instance_crn); this provisions it.

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud API key with permissions to provision the listed services.

prerequisites.name: region
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud region where watsonx.ai is available (e.g. us-south, eu-de).

prerequisites.name: resource_group_name
prerequisites.description: Name of the resource group to create or reuse.

notes: Anchor DA (watsonx-ai/solutions/fully-configurable) composes resource_group + kms + watsonx.ai and takes an EXISTING COS instance as input; the cos module here (role=prerequisite) provisions it.
Add watsonx-governance for model risk governance, or watsonx-discovery for retrieval-augmented generation over documents.
watsonx.ai availability is region-specific; confirm the target region supports the required plans.

compositions.name: vpc-landing-zone
compositions.display_name: Secure VPC Landing Zone with Flow Logs
compositions.description: A multi-zone VPC foundation with an encrypted COS instance capturing VPC flow logs and Cloud Logs for network observability. Anchored on the landing-zone-vpc 'fully-configurable' DA (resource_group + kms + vpc + flow-log bucket), extended with a COS instance and Cloud Logs. A networking base layer other workloads build on.

recommended_modules.purpose: Creates (or references) the resource group that owns the network resources.
Provisions the KMS instance, key ring, and root key used to encrypt the flow-log bucket.
Provisions the VPC, subnets across zones, public gateways, and enables VPC flow logs to COS (the anchor DA's module).
Provisions the COS instance that stores the VPC flow logs. The DA creates the flow-log bucket in an existing COS instance; this provisions the instance.
Provisions IBM Cloud Logs for network and platform log aggregation (not part of the anchor DA).

connections.note: Set enable_vpc_flow_logs = true on the VPC module to route flow logs to this COS instance.

compositions.name: event-streams
compositions.description: An enterprise-plan Event Streams (Kafka) instance with customer-managed encryption (KMS) for an event-driven messaging backbone. Anchored on the event-streams 'security-enforced' DA (resource_group + kms + Event Streams, with credentials written to Secrets Manager).

recommended_modules.purpose: Creates (or references) the resource group that owns the messaging and encryption resources.
Provisions the KMS instance, key ring, and root key used to encrypt Event Streams at rest.
Provisions the enterprise-plan Event Streams (Kafka) instance and topics, encrypted with the KMS key (the anchor DA's module).

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud API key with permissions to provision the listed services.

prerequisites.name: region
prerequisites.description: IBM Cloud region to deploy into (e.g. us-south).

prerequisites.name: resource_group_name
prerequisites.description: Name of the resource group to create or reuse.

notes: Customer-managed encryption on Event Streams requires the enterprise plan.
A service-to-service authorization from Event Streams to KMS is required; kms-all-inclusive can create it.
The anchor DA also writes service credentials into an existing Secrets Manager via secrets-manager//modules/secrets; add a secrets_manager module if you need to provision one.
